parent.result: WSP79 SELFTEST_NEGATIVE 18/19: no degree4 incompatible action channel detected; same-expressivity symbolic exactly tied. Parent untouched.

hypothesis: After newly paid physical interventions, an impossible-to-fit degree<=3 action/output bit can be diagnosed as structural novelty and repaired by compiling new degree4 public ReLU detectors into executable neural weight matrices. A source-blind learner can gain genuinely unpaid prediction coverage without forgetting earlier reliable knowledge.

source.cohort: SELFTEST only, not protected scientific first use
source.families: 5601-5604 independently shuffled sparse degree2 controls; 5605-5608 shuffled sparse degree3 controls; 5609-5612 new four-way AND quartic worlds; 5613-5616 new four-way conjunctions including exactly one complemented sensor. Six public bits, six actions; each action unconditionally toggles its own hidden role bit, with 0..2 extra causal XOR effect targets. 0..3 monomials per effect target. Hidden roles/channel mappings derived by SHA256('WSP80|SELFTEST|seed|purpose'), no dataset cherry-picking.
source.paid_budget: For each seed, two independent source-identical physically charged zero-initialized continuous 384-step sessions. Identical separately paid first144 StageA actions, then240 paid StageB steps: source-blind disagreement/coverage action policy vs SHA-seeded uniform random. 16x2x384=12288 paid actions; no training resets, telemetry beyond paid public before/action/after, arbitrarily state-indexed physics queries or future physics oracle.
source.scoring: Only AFTER full freeze: evaluator-only 64 public states x6 public actions=384 truth labels per source; 32 independent two-action compositions per world; StageA actual correct/confident retention. Report confidence-right, confident-wrong, abstention, forced accuracy, paid/unpaid coverage and source-private hashes per seed.

learner.base: Use WSP79 public degree0..3 42 monomials/action and all <=3-term parity hypotheses consistent with charged public outcomes; source-blind. A genuine structural mismatch only when some action/output bit has ZERO candidate hypotheses consistent with paid evidence. Ambiguous hypothesis votes alone are NOT novelty.
learner.repair: Only on charged contradiction add the 15 degree4 public conjunctions for the implicated action/output, making <=57 monomials/action; search <=3-term sparse GF2 survivors. Compile canonical surviving effects to numerical 6-output ReLU weights, and confidence to bounded public input ReLU detectors from charged-consistent unanimity. No hidden physics, source import, source family, private labels or symbolic candidate solver at cold inference. If still inconsistent, abstain.
learner.ceiling: <=342 public action-conditioned monomial ReLU units plus <=384 public-query confidence ReLU units, 6 numerical output heads. No neural gradient steps. Count numerical params, offline symbolic search/memory, all physical actions and inference CPU. Every new detector must be explained by a paid inconsistency witness.
learner.action_policy: Deterministic source-blind disagreement/coverage based only on available charged hypotheses and current physical public state, with fixed public tie-breaking; never simulator lookahead or free reset. Compare with independently paid random B.
learner.retention: StageA snapshot at 144 real actions, StageB at 384, both numerically cold restored; old StageA evaluator-verified confident correct retained after repair.
